## Google Cloud Platform Security Command Center Dashboard
---

This workbook visualizes Google Cloud Platform Security Command Center findings to provide insights into security risks, misconfigurations, and affected projects, helping teams prioritize and manage GCP security effectively.

parameters.name: Severity
parameters.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| distinct Severity

content.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Category = tostring(Findings.category)
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| extend State = tostring(Findings.state)
| extend ScannerName = tostring(Findings.sourceProperties.ScannerName)
| extend ResourceName = tostring(FindingsResource.name)
| extend ProjectDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
| extend OrganizationDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.organization)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where ProjectDisplayName in ({Project})
| summarize TotalFindings = count()
content.title: Total Findings

content.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| extend ProjectDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where ProjectDisplayName in ({Project})
| summarize Count = count() by Severity
| order by Count desc
content.title: Severity Distribution

content.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Category = tostring(Findings.category)
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| extend State = tostring(Findings.state)
| extend FindingClass = tostring(Findings.findingClass)
| extend ScannerName = tostring(Findings.sourceProperties.ScannerName)
| extend ResourceName = tostring(FindingsResource.name)
| extend ProjectDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
| extend OrganizationDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.organization)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where ProjectDisplayName in ({Project})
| summarize FindingCount = count() by FindingClass
content.title: Finding Class Distribution

content.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Category = tostring(Findings.category)
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| extend ProjectDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where ProjectDisplayName in ({Project})
| summarize Count = count() by Category
| order by Count desc
| take 10
content.title: Top Findings Categories

content.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| extend ProjectDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where ProjectDisplayName in ({Project})
| summarize Count = count() by ProjectDisplayName
| order by Count desc
content.title: Findings by Project

content.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| extend ScannerName = tostring(Findings.sourceProperties.ScannerName)
| extend ProjectDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where ProjectDisplayName in ({Project})
| summarize Count = count() by ScannerName
| order by Count desc
content.title: Findings by Scanner Type

content.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Category = tostring(Findings.category)
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| extend State = tostring(Findings.state)
| extend ResourceName = tostring(FindingsResource.name)
| extend ProjectDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where ProjectDisplayName in ({Project})
| where Severity in ("High", "Critical")
| project TimeGenerated, Category, ProjectDisplayName, ResourceName, Severity, State
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Detailed Security Findings

content.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Category = tostring(Findings.category)
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| extend ProjectDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where ProjectDisplayName in ({Project})
| summarize Count = count() by Category, Severity
content.title: Findings by Category and Severity

content.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| extend State = tostring(Findings.state)
| extend ProjectDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where ProjectDisplayName in ({Project})
| extend ComplianceStatus = iff(State == "ACTIVE", "Failed", "Passed")
| summarize
    TotalFindings = count(),
    Failed = countif(ComplianceStatus == "Failed"),
    Passed = countif(ComplianceStatus == "Passed")
    by ProjectId = ProjectDisplayName
| extend ComplianceRate = round(100.0 * Passed / TotalFindings, 2)
| sort by TotalFindings desc
content.title: Project Compliance Summary

content.query:
GoogleCloudSCC
| extend Category = tostring(Findings.category)
| extend Severity = tostring(Findings.severity)
| extend State = tostring(Findings.state)
| extend ResourceName = tostring(FindingsResource.name)
| extend ProjectDisplayName = tostring(FindingsResource.gcpMetadata.projectDisplayName)
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where Severity in ({Severity})
| where ProjectDisplayName in ({Project})
| extend ServiceDomain = extract(@"//([a-z]+)\.googleapis\.com", 1, ResourceName)
| extend ResourceType = case(
    ServiceDomain == "storage", "Cloud Storage Bucket",
    ServiceDomain == "compute", "Compute / Firewall Resource",
    ServiceDomain == "iam", "IAM Service Account",
    ServiceDomain == "apikeys", "API Key",
    ServiceDomain == "dns", "Cloud DNS Zone",
    "Other")
| extend ComplianceStatus = iff(State == "ACTIVE", "Failed", "Passed")
| summarize
    TotalFindings = count(),
    Critical = countif(Severity == "Critical"),
    High = countif(Severity == "High"),
    Medium = countif(Severity == "Medium"),
    Low = countif(Severity == "Low"),
    Failed = countif(ComplianceStatus == "Failed"),
    UniqueResources = dcount(ResourceName)
    by ResourceType
| sort by TotalFindings desc
content.title: Findings by Resource Type
